ValidationRule.description: SAL-4862. Validation rule that limits the Lead Source options for users, except admin and Marketo SAL-5415: Users added Cecilia, Sarah C and Barbara Dumbili
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'B - Marketo Integration', $User.User_LongID__c <> '005f2000009yztxAAA', $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000AFZm6QAH', $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000BV7osQAD', $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000EqchWQAR', $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000GLcR3QAL', OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(LeadSource)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(LeadSource))), TEXT(LeadSource)<>"Partner", TEXT(LeadSource)<>"Referral", TEXT(LeadSource)<>"Sourcing", TEXT(LeadSource)<>"Sourcing - LinkedIn", TEXT(LeadSource)<>"Zoominfo" ) && Lead_Val_Bypass__c = False
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only update the Lead Source to Partner, Referral, Sourcing, Sourcing - LinkedIn or Zoominfo
